subject: Future Tech
title: Level 3: The Handoff Problem
description: A quick, practical guide to Level 3: The Handoff Problem.

hook.text: At Level 3, the car says: 'I'm driving now, relax.' Then suddenly: 'Your turn!' Can a distracted human take over safely?

buildup.text: Level 3 allows the driver to watch a movie or text.

discovery.text: Studies show humans need 10-15 seconds to regain situational awareness after being disengaged.

twist.text: Mercedes is the only company offering certified Level 3 in some markets.

climax.text: Many companies skip Level 3 entirely, jumping from Level 2 to Level 4. The handoff problem is just too dangerous.

punchline.text: Partial autonomy might be more dangerous than none at all.

quiz.question: Why do some companies skip Level 3 autonomy?
options: The handoff from machine to human is too dangerous
